name: Gong Jian
profile: Listed by Hurun as founder of 'The Little Bear' (valued ~$2B). The Little Bear (Xiaopangxiong, 小胖熊) is a Shanghai B2B home-renovation building-materials platform; Chinese press (Jiemian) names Niu Dalong as founder and controller, and does not mention Gong Jian. Could not verify Gong Jian's link to the company.
interesting_fact: The Little Bear (Xiaopangxiong) raised nearly $400M in its C and C+ rounds, the C+ led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2.
notes: Identity unresolved: Jiemian names Niu Dalong (牛大龙) as founder of 小胖熊; a CB Insights listing reportedly names 'Jian Gong' but could not be opened (403). Hurun's 'SaaS' label also doesn't match the B2B materials business. Verify before outreach.

name: Ramki Gaddipati
current_role: Co-founder, APAC CEO and Global CTO, Zeta
profile: Co-founded Bengaluru/US banking-tech company Zeta in 2015 with Bhavin Turakhia, building its cloud-native card-processing and core-banking stack. Before Zeta he spent over a decade at the Directi Group and earlier worked at Morgan Stanley in India building data services and middleware. He now runs Zeta's Asia-Pacific business as well as global technology.
interesting_fact: Holds two master's degrees from BITS Pilani (management and software systems) and earlier co-founded Bridle Information and Technology Solutions.
deep_cut_fact: His first startup, Bridle, was billed as 'BITS Pilani's First Incubated Company' in the 2004 alumni magazine Sandpaper, supported by the BITS Technology Business Incubator (he appears as 'Rama Krishna (Ramki)').

public_contacts.value: Zeta contact page (lists media-relations and analyst-relations emails, obfuscated)

notes: Zeta's site publishes a media-relations email behind Cloudflare obfuscation; open the contact page in a browser to read it. Writes bylined articles (Entrepreneur India, Inc42).

name: Michael Wolff Jensen
current_role: EVP & Chief Legal Officer, Ascendis Pharma; Chairman, VISEN Pharmaceuticals and Vicore Pharma (per Ascendis bio)
profile: Danish lawyer and biotech executive, a long-time leader at Ascendis Pharma (board chairman 2008-2021, acting CFO 2008-2013, CLO since 2013, EVP since 2023). He chairs VISEN Pharmaceuticals, the China joint venture Ascendis set up to bring its TransCon endocrine drugs to Greater China, which Hurun counts as a $1B unicorn. Earlier he was CFO of Genmab and LifeCycle Pharma.
interesting_fact: Before Ascendis's rise he was CFO of Genmab (2000-2003) and of LifeCycle Pharma (2003-2008), and chaired the Ascendis board for 13 years.
deep_cut_fact: An energy-sector detour: from 2010 to 2013 he was Senior Legal Advisor and Head of Partnerships (France) in the renewable-energy division of Orsted (formerly DONG Energy), alongside his Ascendis work.
notes: Hurun lists him as VISEN 'founder'; he is its chairman (joined at Series B). An aggregator noted VISEN directorate changes effective 27 June 2025, so confirm he is still chairman. VISEN's site no longer names him.

name: Wojciech Biela
current_role: Co-founder, Starburst (Senior Director of Engineering as of 2022 company blog)
profile: Polish engineer who co-founded Starburst, the data-lakehouse/query company built on the open-source Trino (formerly Presto) engine. He came from the Hadapt team acquired by Teradata in 2014, where he worked on Presto, and built Starburst's core engineering team in Warsaw.
interesting_fact: The Hadapt/Teradata team that founded Starburst kept working on Presto, which was later renamed Trino after a trademark dispute; Starburst's engineering core stayed in Warsaw.
deep_cut_fact: He was recruited to build the Warsaw engineering team by his college friend and fellow co-founder Kamil Bajda-Pawlikowski, and personally worked on closing Starburst's first EMEA customer, Zalando; he called Starburst 'not my first startup, but by far the most special.'
notes: Low public profile; the company blog is the main source. Current title could not be confirmed beyond the 2022 post.

name: Roey Izkovsky
profile: Co-founder and CTO of Simply (formerly JoyTunes), the Tel Aviv music-learning app company he co-founded in 2011 with the Kaminka brothers. He died unexpectedly in March 2024 at age 44, per Calcalist (CTech).
notes: Deceased: Calcalist/CTech reported on 25 Mar 2024 that he 'passed away unexpectedly' at 44 (https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/h1iwkhrap). Do not contact; profile skipped per instructions.

name: Joshua Krall
current_role: Co-founder & CTO, Puck (per TheOrg; unverified by primary source)
profile: Software engineer who co-founded Boom Technology (Boom Supersonic) with Blake Scholl and Joe Wilding in Denver in September 2014; Boom is developing the Overture supersonic airliner. He led Boom's technology/software side (described as CTO) and later moved on; aggregator profiles list him as co-founder and CTO of a startup called Puck since 2020.
interesting_fact: Wikipedia lists Josh Krall as one of Boom Technology's three founders, alongside Blake Scholl and Joe Wilding, with the company founded September 26, 2014 in Denver.
deep_cut_fact: As Boom's CTO he went on the Big Compute podcast to explain how Boom used cloud-based high-performance computing to design a supersonic airliner as a startup.
notes: No longer at Boom (Contrary Research names a different current CTO). Current role (Puck, ex-OpenAtlas partner) comes only from TheOrg. Earlier Groupon/FeeFighters links are from aggregators and unverified. No published contact found; Boom is not a route to him.

name: Tushar Ahluwalia
current_role: Co-founder and (at least until recently) CEO, Razor Group, Berlin
profile: German-raised entrepreneur of Indian heritage who co-founded Berlin-based Razor Group in 2020 to acquire and scale Amazon Marketplace merchants into multichannel consumer brands. Razor raised $400M in May 2021 and $125M in October 2021, passing a $1B valuation. He previously built e-commerce businesses in Asia and Europe after starting at Rocket Internet.
interesting_fact: Razor Group reached unicorn status within about 18 months of founding, after raising $400M (May 2021) and $125M (Oct 2021).
deep_cut_fact: After finishing a Masters in Management at London Business School in 2011 (bachelor's at EBS in Germany), he joined Rocket Internet, which sent him to India to build e-commerce businesses; he describes himself as from a third-generation Indian family raised in Germany.
notes: One aggregator (village.ai) suggests he left the Razor co-CEO role in Oct 2025 for a stealth company. Not confirmed; check before outreach. Has appeared on podcasts about Razor's ~300 acquisitions.

name: Tim Parlett
current_role: Start-up consultant (as of a 2020 report); former Zopa co-founder and COO
profile: One of the five co-founders of Zopa, which launched in the UK in March 2005 as the world's first peer-to-peer lending marketplace and became a licensed bank in 2020. The founding team came from internet bank Egg. Parlett served as Zopa's chief operating officer until 2008 and was later reported to be a consultant for start-ups.
interesting_fact: Zopa was founded in Buckinghamshire in 2004 by a team from internet bank Egg, launched P2P lending in March 2005, and got a full UK banking licence in 2020.
notes: Very low public profile; little recent coverage. Some aggregators call him Zopa's CTO, but a 2020 Alternative Credit Investor piece says COO until 2008 and now a start-up consultant (https://alternativecreditinvestor.com/2020/04/28/where-are-they-now-the-p2p-lending-giants-still-run-by-their-founding-members/). No published contact.

name: Jaynti Kanani
current_role: Founder, Morphic (AI creative/video studio); Polygon co-founder (stepped back 2023)
profile: Indian engineer from Ahmedabad who co-founded Matic Network in 2017 with Sandeep Nailwal and Anurag Arjun; it became Polygon, a leading Ethereum scaling network. He stepped back from Polygon leadership in 2023 and now builds Morphic, an AI studio for consistent, controllable images, video and stories, launched as Morphic Studio in July 2024.
interesting_fact: On Product Hunt he introduces himself as 'JD here, Founder of Morphic', pitching an all-in-one AI creative studio for cinematic images, videos and stories.
deep_cut_fact: Before crypto he was a senior software engineer at Persistent Systems (from 2011) and then a data scientist at real-estate startup Housing.com (from Dec 2014), freelancing before co-founding Matic in 2017.
notes: He announced on X (4 Oct 2023) that he had stepped back from Polygon about six months earlier. Best route is likely X (@jdkanani) or Morphic. Indian media profiles focus heavily on his family's finances; avoid that angle.
